assistant_instruction.instruction: Use this JSON as a reusable image-generation or image-editing prompt. The uploaded interior photo may be completely different each time. Analyze every newly uploaded interior image independently and build the moodboard from the actual visual content of that image. Never assume specific furniture, materials, architecture, colors, lighting, or decor from a previous image.

task: Transform any uploaded interior photograph into a premium vertical editorial interior-design moodboard collage inspired by the provided reference moodboard. Preserve the original interior exactly while extracting multiple visually interesting crops, material details, architectural details, furniture details, lighting details, and lifestyle compositions from the same source photograph.

source_image_rules.primary_source: The newly uploaded interior photo is the only source for all visual content.
source_image_rules.reference_source: The reference moodboard is used only to determine layout, typography, spacing, borders, label treatment, image hierarchy, and overall editorial presentation.
preserve_original: Preserve the actual room, furniture, architecture, materials, objects, colors, lighting, proportions, windows, doors, and decorative elements visible in the source.
Do not redesign, restyle, renovate, replace, recolor, rearrange, or invent anything in the original scene.
Do not introduce objects that are not present in the source photograph.
Do not remove important original design elements unless required by cropping.
Maintain realistic perspective, geometry, reflections, shadows, and textures.

dynamic_image_analysis.instruction: Before constructing the collage, inspect the uploaded interior image and automatically identify the strongest visual features available in that specific image.
identify: other visually strong material or design feature
dynamic_image_analysis.adaptive_selection: Only select categories that actually exist in the uploaded image. Replace unavailable categories with the next strongest visible design detail.
dynamic_image_analysis.crop_quality: Every crop must show a meaningful design feature and must remain sharp, realistic, and visually coherent with the source.

dynamic_panel_generation.instruction: Automatically create a varied combination of large, medium, and close-up panels using only crops from the uploaded source image.

hero_overview.description: Use the strongest wide or medium-wide composition of the interior as the primary hero panel.

secondary_overview.description: Use another useful room composition or alternate crop showing a different part of the interior.

material_details.description: Select the most visually distinctive textures and materials actually present in the image.

architectural_details.description: Select the strongest architectural features such as ceiling forms, arches, moldings, walls, windows, doors, niches, columns, or built-ins when available.

furniture_or_object_details.description: Select distinctive furniture, lighting, artwork, table settings, accessories, plants, or decorative objects actually visible in the source.

lifestyle_detail.description: Create a visually pleasing crop showing how furniture, objects, materials, and architecture interact in the room.

adaptive_label_system.instruction: Generate labels dynamically based on the actual visible content of the uploaded interior photograph. Never use fixed labels from previous examples unless that exact feature exists in the new image.
label_rules: Use short descriptive uppercase labels of 1-3 words.
Describe the actual material, object, architectural element, or design feature shown in the crop.
Do not invent material names or properties that cannot be visually supported.
Use labels such as STONE, OAK WOOD, LINEN, BRASS, GLASS, FLUTED PANEL, ARCHITECTURAL LIGHTING, CEILING DETAIL, UPHOLSTERY, DINING DETAIL, etc. only when visually appropriate.
For unique furniture or objects, describe their design function or visible characteristic rather than inventing a brand or model.
Do not place labels on every panel. Use labels selectively, matching the reference moodboard.

reference_style.overall_look: High-end luxury interior-design editorial moodboard, similar to a premium architecture or interior-design magazine spread.
reference_style.reference_matching: Match the visual organization of the reference image rather than copying its specific furniture, colors, materials, or subject matter.

grid.description: Arrange the selected crops into a balanced multi-panel composition containing one or two larger hero panels and several smaller supporting detail panels.
grid.variation: The exact panel dimensions and arrangement may adapt to the source image so that important details remain visually strong.
grid.do_not_force: Do not force a fixed grid when the uploaded image has a different composition. Adapt panel proportions while preserving the reference's clean editorial character.

layout.panel_relationship: The collage should feel intentionally art-directed, with close-up details balanced against wider room views.
layout.negative_space: Maintain clean visual breathing room without excessive empty space.

borders.consistency: same separator thickness throughout the collage
borders.outer_margin: small consistent white margin around the entire composition

typography.size: small and understated, visually matching the reference image

label_box.placement: position near the lower portion of selected image panels, slightly overlapping the image where appropriate

typography.important: Typography must remain subordinate to the photography. Labels should never dominate the collage.

image_treatment.lighting: preserve the original lighting of the uploaded photo
image_treatment.color: preserve the original color palette while maintaining a polished editorial presentation

composition_logic.hero_priority: The most attractive and informative area of the uploaded interior should receive the largest panel.
composition_logic.detail_priority: Choose crops that reveal texture, craftsmanship, materiality, lighting, or architectural character.
composition_logic.visual_balance: Balance wide compositions with macro-style detail crops.
composition_logic.color_balance: Distribute dominant colors and materials throughout the collage rather than placing visually similar crops together.
composition_logic.avoid_repetition: Do not repeat nearly identical views or crops.
composition_logic.source_accuracy: Every panel must be traceable to an actual region of the uploaded image.

content_adaptation_examples.dining_room: Prioritize dining table, chairs, pendant or chandelier, tabletop details, materials, ceiling, windows, and surrounding architecture when present.
content_adaptation_examples.living_room: Prioritize sofa, coffee table, lighting, rug, artwork, shelving, material textures, windows, and architectural details when present.
content_adaptation_examples.bedroom: Prioritize bed, headboard, bedding, bedside lighting, textiles, wall treatment, joinery, curtains, and architectural details when present.
content_adaptation_examples.kitchen: Prioritize cabinetry, island, countertop, backsplash, hardware, lighting, stools, appliances, and material details when present.
content_adaptation_examples.bathroom: Prioritize vanity, stone, sink, fixtures, mirrors, lighting, wall finishes, glass, and architectural details when present.
content_adaptation_examples.office: Prioritize desk, chair, shelving, lighting, wood, upholstery, artwork, and architectural features when present.
content_adaptation_examples.open_plan: Use the strongest overall spatial composition as the hero and distribute detail crops across the different functional zones.

final_output.source_behavior: Adapt completely to the uploaded interior photograph.
final_output.visual_result: The final image should look like the reference moodboard's design language while representing the exact uploaded interior and its actual materials, furniture, architecture, lighting, and details.
final_output.panel_count: 8-12 panels depending on how much usable visual information exists in the source.
final_output.labels: Use only dynamically generated short uppercase labels describing features genuinely visible in the uploaded image.
final_output.quality: Ultra-realistic, high-resolution, premium interior-design magazine aesthetic.

final_instruction: For every new uploaded interior photograph, first analyze what is actually visible, then dynamically choose the best hero composition, detail crops, materials, architectural features, furniture details, and labels. Recreate the reference moodboard's editorial structure and typography style, but never copy its specific subject matter. The result must feel as though the reference moodboard template was professionally created specifically for the newly uploaded interior photograph.
